figures.title: UniGeom framework
figures.caption: UniGeom maps source history and goal features into a frozen receiver. The lower panel shows the original residual spatial resampling design.
figures.scope: Method architecture; paired observations calibrate the interface. The receiver encoder is absent from the connected deployment route.

figures.title: State correspondence and functional equivalence
figures.caption: Nearby mapped and native states can produce different futures and action preferences under the same frozen dynamics.
figures.scope: Conceptual comparison under a shared frozen receiver; the two routes may prefer different actions.

figures.title: Shared geometry across learned models
figures.caption: Three independently trained LeWM pairs share local neighbors across 606 matched observations per pair.
figures.scope: Neighbors use original 192-dimensional distances. Diamonds mark mean overlap; the dashed line is the 1.65% random-label expectation.

figures.title: Prediction controls
figures.caption: Four directed connections compare native, residual, ridge, state-copy and action-shuffle prediction routes.
figures.scope: Cells print raw one-step feature MSE. Color normalizes by native error within each receiver; lower is better.

figures.title: Learned-source calibration efficiency
figures.caption: Learned and random source encoders are compared at matched calibration trajectory budgets.
figures.scope: Four-step feature MSE; lower is better. Endpoints average three repeats. Horizontal intervals are conditional parent-bootstrap 95% intervals over 606 evaluation parents. Labels show random/learned error ratios.

figures.title: Matched behavior across four tasks
figures.caption: Recorded comparisons span TwoRooms, PushT, driving and Reacher, with matched starts and task conditions within each column.
figures.scope: Selected examples. Comparators are ridge for TwoRooms and Reacher, fixed resampling for PushT, and native perception for driving. Driving shows simulated four-second terminal states with PDM scores; Reacher shows step 1,000 and cumulative return.

figures.title: Predictive interfaces across manipulation tasks
figures.caption: Granular feature-error maps and RoboTwin observed-frame retrievals visualize selected predictions from the paper.
figures.scope: Granular uses two-step forecasts at seed 0 with a common error scale. RoboTwin uses horizon-16 nearest-neighbor RGB readouts from the same 916-frame recorded bank, including true futures. These are post-hoc retrievals, not generated images or executed trajectories; values are forecast feature MSE.

figures.title: Driving observations and saved trajectories
figures.caption: Original front-camera observations accompany saved four-second trajectories and enlarged terminal positions in Boston and Singapore.
figures.scope: Two selected driving replays. Gray is native perception and purple the connected interface. Camera images are original observations; map panels visualize saved simulation states under non-reactive evaluation.
